about: The shot vocabulary: what the vault server's analysis (analyse.rs → POST /api/analysis, Prem's confidential Qwen) says of every ingested picture, so an editor — a person or an LLM — can find and pull the best parts of a shot. Base tags have fixed values (the prompt, the API's validator, the studio and the MCP's find_shots all read them from here); free tags are open. Raise `version` whenever a value is added, renamed or removed.

shot_size.label: Shot size
shot_size.about: EWS extreme wide · WS wide · FS full (head to toe) · MS medium (waist up) · MCU medium close-up (chest up) · CU close-up (face) · ECU extreme close-up (eyes, a detail of a face) · insert (a detail of an object or a hand)

angle.label: Angle
angle.about: eye level · high (looking down) · low (looking up) · overhead (straight down) · dutch (tilted horizon) · POV (what a person sees) · OTS (over the shoulder)

movement.label: Camera movement
movement.about: how the camera moves over the stretch; several may apply (handheld + pan)

lens.label: Lens
lens.about: the lens's character, from perspective and background compression

focal_mm.label: Focal length (est.)
focal_mm.about: an estimated full-frame-equivalent focal length in mm, or leave it out when it cannot be judged

dof.label: Depth of field
dof.about: deep: everything sharp · shallow: the background clearly soft

light_source.label: Light
light_source.about: natural (sun, sky, window) · practical (lamps, screens seen in the picture) · artificial (film lights, off screen)

time_of_day.label: Time of day
time_of_day.about: as the light reads; an interior with no daylight cue reads from its light

contrast.label: Contrast
contrast.about: the light's contrast: low (flat, soft) · high (hard, deep shadows)

location_note.label: Place
location_note.about: the place in a few words: kitchen, city street at night, desk with two screens

who.label: Who
who.about: people by name — only names that are said in the transcript or written in the picture, never guessed

scene.label: Scene
scene.about: what kind of material this is for an edit

quality.label: Quality flags
quality.about: problems an editor must know about; empty when there are none (audio clipping only when the words say so, e.g. a distorted shout)

free.about: free-form tags: lowercase, one to three words each — objects, props, clothing, colours, mood, anything worth finding the shot by

cues.about: time-ranged marks in seconds of the file: s (start), e (end), kind, label (a few words), confidence (0…1), note (optional, one sentence)

kinds.take: one attempt at an action that is repeated (a rolling camera, the actor doing the same again): its in and out. The takes of the same action share take_of (a short name of the action) and are numbered by take (1, 2, …); rank orders them (1 = best) and best marks the best one, with why
kinds.action: what happens: someone enters, picks something up, turns, sits down
kinds.emotion: an actor's expression or tone, from the face and the words: the label is the emotion (calm, joy, doubt, anger, tired, focused …)
kinds.cut: a good in or out point: an action starts or ends, a look, a breath or a pause between sentences — label says which (in / out) and why
kinds.transition: a transition opportunity: a match-cut candidate, motion toward or away from the lens, a whip, a frame that goes dark or bright enough to fade
kinds.highlight: one of the best moments of the file, with a one-line why
kinds.problem: a flub, a false start, a missed line, someone walking in, a bump — what to cut around

summary.about: line: one sentence of what the file shows · best_use: one sentence of where it serves an edit best (an opener, b-roll under a voice-over, the emotional turn …)
